integrity: The package contains an exact self-contained mathematical proof and a standalone finite parameter checker. Computation corroborates but does not replace proof. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for deterministic end-output MSD-first base-b automata with arbitrarily many leading zero digits, b>=2, m>=2 and nonnegative shifts; does not settle the asymptotic sharpness of the quadratic-logarithmic size bound, other automatic sequences, or alternate representation conventions. Priority beyond the inspected primary sources is not certified.
title: Exact most-significant-digit-first state complexity of shifted modular ruler sequences
